info.title: egdata Versioned API
info.description:
Version 1 of the egdata public read-only REST API.

Successful JSON responses use `{ data, meta }`. Paginated collections use opaque forward cursors with `meta.pagination`. Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and `requestId`.

Applications authenticate data operations with an API key through the Cloudflare Worker gateway. `/v1/health`, `/v1/open-api.json`, and CORS preflights are unauthenticated.

The signed-in dashboard API console can alternatively use a project-scoped session lasting at most 10 minutes. Console credentials require that dashboard login and are not portable API keys. Console requests use the same operation permissions and quota admission and count toward project usage.

Administrators can review project limit requests in the developer dashboard. Approved RPM applies to existing and future project API keys and the API console; existing key caches can take up to five minutes to refresh. Custom requests use the enterprise tier with the approved RPM override. Expensive-operation caps remain unchanged and approval does not reset quota counters.

Breaking changes require a new major API version. Additive fields and operations may be introduced within v1.

Shared HTTP caching is disabled on outgoing v1 responses; every request, including conditional requests, passes authentication and exact quota admission before internal Worker/origin caching or private ETag revalidation.

200.description: `data` is an array of achievement-set fields plus `sandboxId`, `achievementSetId`, `unlocked`, `unlockDate`, and an optional `offer` object.

get.summary: Get rarest profile achievements for one sandbox
get.description: Returns up to three of the rarest unlocked achievements for one sandbox, ordered by `completedPercent` ascending. This collection is bounded and not paginated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Epic account ID.

parameters.name: sandboxId
parameters.description: Epic sandbox ID (the base-game namespace).

200.description: `data` is an array of achievement-set fields plus `sandboxId`, `achievementSetId`, `unlocked`, and `unlockDate`.

get.description: Returns the public Epic profile together with aggregate achievement statistics (games played, unlocked achievements, awards, total XP, reviews), the donation details stored for the account, and whether a Discord account is linked. This resource is not paginated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Epic account ID.

get.description: Returns one achievement-completion summary per sandbox the profile has played, ordered by the selected `sort` with `sandboxId` as the unique tie-breaker. Use `platinum=true` to keep only games with a platinum award. `meta.pagination` carries `limit`, `hasMore`, and `nextCursor`; the legacy `page` parameter is replaced by the cursor.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Epic account ID.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward cursor returned as `meta.pagination.nextCursor`. Cursors expire after 24 hours and are bound to the operation, filters, ordering, country, locale, and page size.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering of the games: `completion` (default), `alphabetical`, `xp`, or `achievements`.

parameters.name: platinum
parameters.description: When true, only games with at least one platinum award are returned.

200.description: `data.achievements` is the page of per-sandbox summaries with `sandboxId`, `totalUnlocked`, `totalXP`, `productAchievements`, `completionPercentage`, `baseOfferForSandbox`, and `product`. The key keeps the legacy name.

get.description: Returns the full offer for a game the profile has achievement data for. When `sandbox` is supplied, that game is returned instead of a random one. This resource is bounded and not paginated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Epic account ID.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: Optional sandbox ID. Returns that game instead of a random one.

200.description: `data` is the serialized offer document, including `id`, `namespace`, `title`, `productSlug`, and `keyImages`.

get.description: Returns total document counts for offers, items, tags, assets, price-engine rows, changelogs, sandboxes, and products, plus the number of offers and items created in the current year. Counts are cached for one hour.
Returns the number of base-game releases per month since the Epic Games Store launch in December 2018. Pre-purchases and code-redemption-only offers are excluded. Results are cached for one day.
Returns the number of base-game releases per year since the Epic Games Store launch in December 2018. Pre-purchases and code-redemption-only offers are excluded. Results are cached for one day.
Returns the number of base-game offers created per month since December 2018. Pre-purchases and code-redemption-only offers are excluded. Results are cached for one day.
Returns the number of base-game offers created per year since December 2018. Pre-purchases and code-redemption-only offers are excluded. Results are cached for one day.

Returns the counters shown on the egdata homepage: tracked offers, price changes observed in the last 72 hours, active discounts, and current giveaways. Counts are resolved for the Epic pricing region that contains `country`. Cookies are never used; `country` defaults to US.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 pricing country. Defaults to US; cookies are never used.

get.description: Returns a franchise and a cursor-paginated page of its offers, ordered by `releaseDate` descending with the offer `id` ascending as tie-breaker. Offers are localized with `locale` and priced for the Epic pricing region that contains `country`. The `stats` object aggregates achievements and time-to-beat data over every offer in the franchise, not only the returned page. Cookies are never used.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Franchise slug, as used by `/franchises/{slug}`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 pricing country. Defaults to US; cookies are never used.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: BCP 47 locale for localized text. Defaults to en-US; cookies are never used.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward cursor returned as `meta.pagination.nextCursor`. Cursors expire after 24 hours and are bound to the operation, filters, ordering, country, locale, and page size.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.

get.description: Returns the storefront modules for The Game Awards event, each with its localized and expanded offers and current regional price. Modules are ordered by `moduleIndex`; modules without referenced offers are omitted. OG image generation remains outside v1.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 pricing country. Defaults to US; cookies are never used.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: BCP 47 locale for localized text. Defaults to en-US; cookies are never used.

200.description: `data` is an array of modules with `title`, `moduleIndex`, `moduleType`, and serialized `offers`.

get.description: Looks up a single catalog asset by its Epic Games artifact ID and returns the serialized asset document. Returns `404` when no asset matches.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Epic Games artifact ID of the asset.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Version 1 API key from the egdata Developer Portal. `Authorization: Bearer <key>` is also accepted; sending two different credentials is rejected.

BearerAuth.description: Version 1 API key passed as a Bearer credential.
